'''Premiere Unlimited Starter Deck''' (printed as a 60 card starter set) is a 60-card [[Premiere Unlimited]] product published by [[Decipher]] in February 1996.<ref name="decipher-date">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/thecollection/index.html Star Wars CCG: The Expansions], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990504174938id_/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/thecollection/index.html Internet Archive].</ref> MSRP was $9.95. Each starter mixes Light and Dark white-border Premiere cards plus a rulebook. Titles vary by pack. A display held 12 starters.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive] (8 October 2026).</ref>
